title: Shapes and Their Attributes
description: Identify shapes by defining attributes, count sides and corners, explain what makes a square, compose shapes, and draw shapes from rules.
learningFocus: Describe and identify two-dimensional shapes by defining attributes such as sides, corners, equal sides, and square corners, then compose and draw shapes from those attributes.
adultGuidance: Ask your child how they know before naming a shape, and encourage them to count sides and corners or point out equal sides and square corners. If a turned square is called a different shape, rotate a square object together and discuss which defining attributes stayed the same.

seo.title: Shapes and Their Attributes | Grade 1 Worksheets
seo.description: Five printable Grade 1 geometry worksheets for defining shape attributes, sides and corners, squares, composing shapes, and drawing from rules.
